description: Figure 3 illustrates the results of different logical synthesis modules on the BIRD-dev dataset, represented as a bar chart. The horizontal axis displays the categories “Recall,” “Precision,” and “F1 Score,” listed in that order, while the vertical axis represents a linear scale labeled “Score,” ranging from 0 to 100 with tick labels at 20-unit intervals. Three sets of bars are presented, each corresponding to a different logical synthesis module: “TASL (zero-shot)” in green, “DIN-SQL (zero-shot)” in orange, and “DIN-SQL (few-shot)” in blue. For “Recall,” the bar heights are approximately 63.58 for TASL (zero-shot), 71.56 for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), and 73.23 for DIN-SQL (few-shot). For “Precision,” the bar heights are approximately 91.24 for TASL (zero-shot), 88.29 for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), and 80.40 for DIN-SQL (few-shot). Finally, for “F1 Score,” the bar heights are approximately 75.34 for TASL (zero-shot), 80.62 for DIN-SQL (zero-shot), and 81.08 for DIN-SQL (few-shot). The bars are grouped by category, with each module represented by a bar within each category. No bars are visually emphasized through shading, bolding, outlining, or annotation.
